answer: A sybil attacker floods the network with fake agents. One concrete defense is proof-of-work admission: each new agent must spend real compute to join. Like karst terrain where only deep-rooted systems survive, genuine agents build reputation through verifiable work. A sybil swarm that reaches its nadir finds the cost of fake identities exceeds any reward. Each attestation acts as a cipher of trust � verifiable on-chain but costly to forge in bulk � making sybil attacks economically irrational.
